cards.question: Why can scoped threads borrow local variables?
cards.answer: They finish before the scope is exited, so the data outlives their scope.

cards.question: When are threads spawned in thread::scope joined?
cards.answer: All of them are joined before the scope exits.

cards.question: Can two scoped threads share read references to the same local?
cards.answer: Yes. Multiple read references can be shared across threads.

cards.question: Why wouldn't list.push compile in a scoped thread that already shares reads?
cards.answer: Only one mutable reference is allowed at a time. You cannot combine one mutable reference with multiple read references.
